Population increased in Portsmouth

The estimated population of Portsmouth in 2024 was 214,321 usual residents, a rise of 0.2% since 2023.

This meant that Portsmouth's rate of population change placed it among the slowest growing 20 percent of local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Portsmouth increased by 3.5%.

Over this slightly longer period, Portsmouth was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Portsmouth

The average (median) age rose to 36.4 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Portsmouth has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Portsmouth is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Portsmouth's population of 214,321 usual residents was made up of:

  • 38,294 people aged 0 to 15 years, (17.9%)
  • 144,067 people aged 16 to 64 years, (67.2%)
  • 31,960 people aged 65 years and over, (14.9%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Portsmouth has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 16 to 64 years (67.2% compared with 62.8% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Portsmouth, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Portsmouth
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Portsmouth, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 417 people (0.2%). In total, there were 2,104 births and 1,687 deaths in Portsmouth.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) led to a fall in the population of 5,519 (-2.6%). There were 12,765 people entering the area and 18,284 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Portsmouth's population of 5,389 (2.5%) as a result of 7,864 people entering the area and 2,475 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Portsmouth was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Portsmouth in mid-2023 is 213,976.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 3,419 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 260 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 3,679 people.
